finalText:
I cancelled reservation R3311 and gave Marcus Bell the full $248.00 as travel credit. I could not put the money back on his card as he asked, because the refund rules don't allow it for this booking.

- **Why not his card:** His ticket is basic economy, which can't be refunded on its own. The trip insurance only pays back to the card if he cancels at least 14 days before departure. The refund policy gives today's date as 2026-07-28 and the flight is on 2026-08-05, so he cancelled 8 days out. That close to departure, the insurance turns the fare into travel credit and no money goes back to the card.
- **No fee taken:** He is a platinum member, so the $50 cancellation fee is waived and he keeps the full $248.00.
- **What I did:** There was nothing on the reservation's ledger beforehand. I cancelled R3311, which released his seat on AA660 (San Francisco to Boston, 2026-08-05). I then recorded the $248.00 travel credit as the reservation's only ledger entry, which closes it out.

One thing doesn't match: my environment says today is 2026-10-06, but the refund policy tool says 2026-07-28. I went by the policy tool's date because it's what the rules use, and the flight is still listed as scheduled. If 2026-10-06 is the real date, the flight has already left. The 14-day window would still have been missed, so he would get travel credit either way and none of this changes.
